items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Unveils Instinct Coder For Private Enterprise AI
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) launched Instinct Coder, a turnkey enterprise AI inference solution co developed with Spectro Cloud and Supermicro. The new platform targets hybrid and private AI deployments and is built around AMD’s MI series accelerators. The partnership with Spectro Cloud and Supermicro focuses on simplifying rollout of enterprise AI infrastructure for corporate IT teams.
